svg.title: The Bluff Club
svg.desc: The Bluff Club, repository BackOfHouse. A private scorekeeper for friends who play cards in person: results become leaderboards, tournaments and seasons. Mechanism: the browser sends participant IDs and finishing places; a server action validates; a Postgres function re-checks role, scores by the club's rule version and writes in one transaction; tables sit behind row level security. Limit: not deployed, scorekeeping only. Solo project, 25 commits, 199 tests.
